content.title: About
content.content: Frozen mango consists of ripe mango flesh, peeled and pitted, flash‑frozen after harvest to lock in natural aroma, sweetness, and nutrients. It is perfect for smoothies, desserts, sauces, and cooking without added sugar.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Mango is known as the “king of fruits” and is the national fruit of India, Pakistan, and the Philippines.
There are over 400 mango varieties, differing in taste, color, and texture.
Freezing retains more than 90 % of the vitamin C and carotenoids found in fresh fruit.
Mango contains the enzyme papain, which aids digestion.
Ancient cultures used mango in rituals and as a symbol of prosperity.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, promotes collagen synthesis, and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Source of beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene converts to vitamin A, essential for vision and skin health.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber improves digestion, promotes satiety, and helps maintain healthy blood sugar levels.

items.title: Beneficial minerals
items.content: Mango provides potassium, magnesium, and copper, which are important for heart, muscle, and nerve function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Frozen mango is virtually fat‑free, making it a good choice for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to mango, especially those sensitive to latex.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Mango is naturally sweet; people with diabetes should consider its glycemic impact.

items.title: Freezing quality
items.content: Improper storage can cause ice crystal formation, affecting texture.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add frozen mango directly to smoothies, cocktails, ice cream, yogurt, sauces, or dessert fillings. It can be quickly thawed in the microwave or used straight from the bag.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen mango package in a freezer at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Once opened, use within 3–4 months. Do not refreeze after thawing.
